description: This source file defines an OkHttp interceptor class that attaches an Authorization header with a Bearer token from the TokenStore to outgoing HTTP requests, unless the request is targeting an authentication endpoint. It involves asynchronous token retrieval managed synchronously via runBlocking due to OkHttp's interceptor constraints.

classes.name: AuthHeaderInterceptor
classes.description: An OkHttp Interceptor that adds Authorization headers with Bearer tokens to HTTP requests, excluding authentication endpoints.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Intercepts HTTP requests to conditionally add an Authorization header if a token exists.
